BASED UPON EXTENSIVE RESEARCH INTO THE VENDORS WHICH CAN PROVIDE A COMMERCIAL SOLUTION AND COMPONENTS FOR THE PROPOSED MEASUREMENT SYSTEM, IT IS DETERMINED THAT MAURY MICROWAVE PROVIDES THE BEST SOLUTION FOR W-BAND VRLP WHICH INTEGRATES INTO MSU'S EXISTING RF MEASUREMENT LABORATORY.TASK 2: RIGOROUS VERIFICATION AND ANALYSISAFTER SUCCESSFUL ACQUISITION OF THE W-BAND ON-WAFER VRLP MEASUREMENT SYSTEM DESCRIBED IN THE PREVIOUS SECTION, THE MSU TEAM WILL RIGOROUSLY QUALIFY THE COMPLETE SYSTEM USING STANDARD TECHNIQUES DEVELOPED IN PREVIOUS WORK [4].
